# IRSS x Silva21 Expansion Mine

> Agent-facing index for the IRSS x Silva21 Expansion Mine. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [Candidate register](register.html): how the registry is validated, ranked, and rendered.
- [Maintenance](maintenance.html): the review cadence, source refresh, issue/registry drift checks, and what they do not prove.
- [Release notes and known gaps](releases.html): what the `0.1.0` release contains, how to reproduce it, and what it does not cover.
- [Generated register](https://github.com/UBC-FRESH/irss-expansion/blob/main/docs/candidates.md): the browsable candidate queue.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.
